title: 2026-10-25 News
lede: It's a heavy day for model releases and light on peer-review or citation work. The open-weights Kimi 3.1 Pro, described as Fable-5.1-class, is the story people will talk about. For your own research, the most useful items are an arXiv paper on why AI-generated language is hard to understand and a thread on ICLR 2027 desk rejects aimed at "AI slop".
